Yzaguirre.e: Borrowed from Spanish Yzaguirre, itself of Basque origin.

d.g: The long-term efforts by Steve Yzerman to secure the success of the Detroit Red Wings.
d.x: The fourth chapter of the Yzerplan brought the most change to the Red Wings roster. Out went head coach Jeff Blashill and in came a new bench boss in Derek Lalonde.
